svg.title: Provider observations and bounded global resolution
svg.desc: A validated pack is evaluated through explicit live capability gates or supplied recorded bytes. Every live attempt reserves persistent budget and preserves raw receipts. An explicit observation branch feeds bounded exact subset resolution, whose incomplete runs yield no selected candidates.
